text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Uni-san! So this is where you were... 
wait.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ? Um, what are you doing over there?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Transmitting" "Signal" to "Precious One".

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see! You're sending a message to 
someone precious to you!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Can Zenno Rob Roy "Comprehend" this 
"Signal"?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's see... It's kind of swaying, 
and something you want to convey to a 
precious person...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
......U-Um! Could it be, "Eat seaweed and 
stay healthy", or something like that?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ..."LOS". Neo Universe has "Failed".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Changing method. Will "RETY".

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I understand...! Next you'll convey your 
feelings through a drawing!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Complete". Requesting "ANLZ".

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This is... mid-warp? I wonder. It has a 
futuristic vibe, and feels hopeful...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! I got it! "Believe in the 
possibilities of the future", or something 
like that...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "LOS". Time to "RETY".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! What a powerful canzone d'amore! My 
heart, my soul is overflowing with 
dolcissimo...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe's "SOUL"... Will this 
"Reach"?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! This time for sure...! What Uni-san 
wants to convey is, in other words—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So much that the heart trembles and the 
chest burns with passion... I love natto!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "LOS". This is "No Good" either...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: If it has come to this—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I visited the rooftop for a break 
from work, I ended up getting swept into 
Neo Universe's ritual.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Hello" "Hello". "Transmitting" from 
"Earth Alpha"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ..."LOS". It's a "Landing Failure".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe is "Troubled". "NLDG"... 
"NLDG"...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... If only I could catch the 
"Signal" better...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um! Uni-san, you want to convey your 
feelings to someone precious, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about giving handmade 
sweets, just like on Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Handmade"...? But today is a different 
day from "Valentine's"...
choice_data_list:
You don't need to worry too much about 
that

You don't need to worry too much about 
that

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I gave sweets to Uni-san on 
an ordinary day before too...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I made them using a recipe that appeared 
in a story. They turned out great, so 
Uni-san, you should definitely try it 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to share this excitement with 
someone. Let's eat together, Uni-san!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."Analysis Complete". "Sweets" are a 
"Signal".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sfera. Neo Universe will execute "Handmade 
Sweets".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "EIO". "Thank you".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe aims for "HPED".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."Unknown Factor". Cooking is a "Black 
Box".

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine, Uni-san is smart! As long 
as you understand the recipe, you can 
definitely do it!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...? Already did "Conveyed"? If so, 
"Landing Complete". Neo Universe is 
"Happy".

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Eh, Uni-san!?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Fufufu. "Connect", indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't quite understand it, but it 
seemed Neo Universe had achieved a 
satisfying result.
